high_value_findings.finding: A sequence of whitespace/escaping/markdown changes eventually broke [TOOLS USED] parsing because a human-readable double-newline delimiter was also structured protocol state; frozen HEAD repairs that regression.
high_value_findings.transfer: Structured tool/control metadata must be parsed as typed data before escaping/normalization/rendering and must not depend on human-readable whitespace delimiters.

high_value_findings.finding: Natural-language user text was parsed by an LLM into durable policy category/enforcement/threshold fields, including hard policies.
high_value_findings.transfer: LLM policy interpretation is a proposal/extraction stage; hard policy promotion needs schema validation, ambiguity handling and independent commit authority.

high_value_findings.finding: Parallel strategy runs used success/failure counts and automatically wrote a winner into the active goal strategy.
high_value_findings.transfer: Automatic experiment-to-control promotion requires valid outcome metrics, comparable conditions, uncertainty and independent promotion authority rather than absence-of-error as the principal proxy.

high_value_findings.finding: A hardcoded architecture fact made Frank say AURA despite training and another fact claimed a ThoughtSeedVAE that did not exist.
high_value_findings.transfer: Runtime architecture grounding should derive from authoritative machine-readable topology/version state, not duplicated prompt prose.

high_value_findings.finding: Tool-tag variants leaked, keyword intent routing remained brittle, and evaluation found harmful request/tool paths before input and tool-layer filters were expanded.
high_value_findings.transfer: Maintain defense-in-depth across intent routing, authority/effect execution and output display; continuously adversarial-test each layer and preserve false-positive/false-negative evidence.

high_value_findings.finding: Project Engine combined browser/email/scheduling/budget/trading/credential state and autonomous action chaining. The source describes credential vault encryption as XOR cipher.
high_value_findings.transfer: High-authority project agents require real secret management, scoped capabilities, approvals/limits, effect receipts, rollback and outcome auditing; labels such as encrypted/autonomous do not establish security or correctness.

high_value_findings.finding: README/roadmap promoted autonomy/cost/recall/model-size and future capability claims while roadmap scope and amounts changed across adjacent commits.
high_value_findings.transfer: Benchmark metrics and roadmap/funding statements remain source-reported, epoch-bound claim/provenance records until independently reconstructed or implemented.
